attributes.title: A high-resolution snow dataset for Switzerland (2016–2025) combining physics-based simulations and in situ observations
attributes.summary: This dataset provides estimates of snow depth, snow water equivalent, snow cover fraction, and snowmelt runoff for Switzerland and hydrologically connected neighboring regions for water years 2016–2025.It combines physics-based model simulations with in situ snow observations through data assimilation, offering a spatially and temporally consistent record of Alpine snowpack dynamics. The dataset contains daily values and has a spatial resolution of 250m and an extent of 365000 by 272000m.
attributes.keywords: snow, snow hydrology, snow depth, snow water equivalent, snow cover fraction, snow melt runoff, Switzerland
attributes.institution: WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research SLF, Davos, Switzerland
attributes.history: File created at 2026-05-27T13:13:04 UTC+01:00 using Matlab R2024b by Moritz Oberrauch.

attributes.summary: This dataset provides estimates of snow depth, snow water equivalent, snow cover fraction, and snowmelt runoff for Switzerland and hydrologically connected neighboring regions for water years 2016–2025.It combines physics-based model simulations with in situ snow observations through data assimilation, offering a spatially and temporally consistent record of Alpine snowpack dynamics. The dataset contains daily values and has a spatial resolution of 250m and an extent of 365000 by 272000m.
attributes.keywords: snow, snow hydrology, snow depth, snow water equivalent, snow cover fraction, snow melt runoff, Switzerland
attributes.institution: WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research SLF, Davos, Switzerland
attributes.history: File created at 2026-05-27T13:12:04 UTC+01:00 using Matlab R2024b by Moritz Oberrauch.
